COST.rule: wall-clock flag at 2x (only commensurable scale; engine op counts are engine-native and reported only); no route by itself (a cost-only claim needs the separate scaling cell)

G0a_KNOWN_ANSWER.rule: 12 hand-authored fixtures + separation pair reproduced by the oracle (selftest)

G0b_ORACLE_SELF_AGREEMENT.rule: Kleene == exhaustive enumeration on every version of every instance

G0c_NULL_CALIBRATION.rule: NEVER_REOPEN exact=0 on instances whose oracle reopens/censors something; GLOBAL_RESET exact=0 on instances whose oracle mixes preserved with reopened/unresolved; RANDOM exact <= 10%; M vs within-instance shuffled oracle labels exact <= 10%

G1a_B5_REPRODUCES_M.rule: M and B5 decisions identical on >= 99.5% of instances and no stratum > 5% discordant

G1b_M_ADVANTAGE.rule: instance-exact diff (M - B5) > 0, exact two-sided p <= 0.05, >= 1 stratum with >= 5 M-only-exact instances

G2_ANTI_CONSERVATISM.rule: on NO_REOPENING_NEEDED and NEW_INDEPENDENT_SUPPORT, M over-reopened commitments <= B5's

G3_MECHANISM.rule: each stratum with a claimed M advantage: the matching omission ablation's exact rate <= B5's on that stratum

G4_INTERFACE_LADDER.rule: no rung k+1 significantly worse than rung k (exact p <= 0.05); rung-5 gap = G1 paired test
